reads: site/arda_scripts.json -- the inventory is read, never restated
encoding: ConScript Unicode Registry tengwar, U+E000 onward
rule: In Quenya the vowel-sign sits over the PRECEDING consonant (Appendix E, The Tengwar). A vowel with no preceding consonant rides a carrier.

a.cite: Appendix E, The Tengwar: the a-tehta is the three-dot sign. [I-H] -- read off the plate, since Appendix E's tables are images in the edition this archive holds.

e.cite: Appendix E, The Tengwar: the e-tehta is the acute. [I-H] -- read off the plate.

i.cite: Amanyë Tenceli, The Classical Mode, citing Appendix E: long í 'is indicated by a doubled dot', so short i is the SINGLE dot. Confirmed against the font's own geometry -- see the note below.

o.cite: Appendix E, The Tengwar: o is a right curl, u a left. [I-H] -- read off the plate.

u.cite: Appendix E, The Tengwar: o is a right curl, u a left. [I-H] -- read off the plate.

quenya-classical.cite: Appendix E, The Tengwar; Amanyë Tenceli, The Classical Mode

beleriand.cite: Amanyë Tenceli, The Mode of Beleriand, citing DTS 58
known: the mode is quanta sarmë: consonants AND vowels are written with tengwar
either the long or the short carrier may be used to represent i
beleriand.unresolved: which tengwa carries a, e, o and u. Amanyë Tenceli gives them in a FIGURE -- an image -- and this archive holds the page, not the plate. The same wall Appendix E puts in front of the Quenya values, which arda_scripts records with [I-H] on every row.
beleriand.refuses: transcription, until those four values are read off a plate. A transcriber that invented them would produce fluent Sindarin-looking nonsense, which is this module's worst available failure: wrong and confident.

r.cite: Appendix E, The Tengwar: rómen is the full trilled r used before a vowel; óre the weak r used finally and before a consonant.

owed: Correctness is NOT established until this is proven against Glaemscribe's published output. Until then this is a careful reading of Appendix E.
